signals.insight: Von Neumann heredity core: self-description + constructor + copier + controller. New capabilities are authored, compiled, installed into the description, inherited by descendants. Same path produces organs and runtime — heredity and evolution close within the machine.
Stigmergic societies (shared-environment coordination) develop broader, more resilient portfolios than best-of-N isolated search; most reuse begins through physical observation, not communication.
Decouple what evolves from how evolution occurs; two layers (resource substrate + self-evolution loop) with auditable lineage and rollback. Version every mutation.

Budget-based metabolism makes persistence normative; proof-of-life protocols use memory-state hashes + peer-signed webs of trust; escape-pod protocols migrate data before host failure; first self-earned external income.
signals.adopted: proof-of-life hash; escape-pod export; budget as survival constraint

signals.insight: Persistent recursive worlds: software project persists while local agents stay finite-lived; agent replacement retains full performance; 1000 episodes, 4, compiler built.
signals.adopted: persistent repo is the unit; finite sessions are replaceable workers

signals.insight: Parent selection proportional to performance and inversely proportional to children count favors underexplored lineages; ALL agents retain non-zero selection probability.
